name: ferry_application_init

ownership.argument: On this firmware init returns1 on success. Wrapper must preserve original result, register in raw registry reached application+100 ->runtime+164 ->manager+4, then return before stock Application::run0xC8D9108 evaluates app environment.

provenance.source: Application primary vtable0x2CDA7C80 slot2 points here.0xC8DB25C calls runtime creator0xC9116F8;0xC8DB264 stores runtime at application+100. Finishes context/binding/i18n setup then MOV r0,#1 and returns. Runtime creation0xC911306 stores Feature manager at runtime+164.
